Stop on breach.

Responsibility: `objectstack packages/verify/src/harness.ts:1167-1172 (read at origin/main d2bc1ffd) | PR #35509 (card #35255) | an app author running os verify on an app that routes objects to a declared managed datasource bound to a real database; read from the code, reach not measured`
Thread-read: 7011470565
Premise: holds. At `origin/main` `d2bc1ffd`, `bootStack` wires `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin({ driverFactory: createDefaultDatasourceDriverFactory() })` whenever the app declares datasources. A declared datasource that an object binds to is connected with its real driver (ADR-0062 D2). After #35509, `deriveCrudCases` blocks only objects on an external datasource, so verify's write families still write through a declared managed datasource.
Route (seat ruling 16:57Z; route B rejected because it would silently degrade verify for such apps): verify hands `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin` its own driver factory. A declared datasource whose `resolveDatasourceSchemaMode` is `managed` gets an ephemeral in-memory store of the same kind as verify's default store, not its real connection. External datasources keep their real driver: reads reach them, and #35509 keeps writes off them. No new flag or interface. If a managed datasource's engine cannot be stood in for faithfully, leave its objects out and name them, as #35509 does; never write through. Composition note: ruling A on #22301 (harness.ts:891, "what serve composes") already has verify swap its own default store for an ephemeral one. This extends the same swap to declared managed stores, and the harness header must say so.
Pre-claim lane: `packages/verify/**` is area b1-B of repo:objectstack#1.
Pre-claim deps: none; no open PR references #35523; overlap-check runs before each push.

**Delivered** · 2026-11-19T21:40Z · PR #35635 merged as 1104ee59e1; this card closed by its `Fixes` line. Under `os verify`, a declared managed datasource on sqlite, sqlite-wasm, postgres, mysql, turso or memory now runs on an in-memory stand-in built from verify's own spec. Nothing of the declared connection reaches it, and the bound objects are still exercised. One reader, `isManagedDatasource` (`resolveDatasourceSchemaMode`), decides both the factory and `deriveCrudCases`. A datasource whose `schemaMode` is spelled only in `config` or `external` keeps its real driver for reads and is withheld from every write family. A managed engine with no faithful stand-in (mongodb, or a plugin driver) keeps its real driver; verify's own derived writes to it are withheld and the report names why. The cascade line item now reads "withheld on purpose — REASON". L1-a ACCEPT 7021917719 (after REWORK 7020917973).

State: `pm:dispatched` removed. Left open: #35640 (p1): during `os verify` the app's own seed and hooks still write to a managed mongodb or plugin-driver datasource. It is being measured now (seat order 21:17Z), and the shape goes to the maintainer.
